rows.diagnostics: cinch: 4:40: a task capture must be `Copy`, a shared `Ref`, or transferred exactly once: bytes is shared across tasks without shareable evidence (concurrency specification, section 3) (in /Users/ian/Documents/ChatGPT/Slang/cinch-bootstrap-work/task-callback-capture-probe-1/direct-mutable-capture.cinch)

scope: Actual current NativeE5 CLI rejects a mutable Bytes capture written directly at spawn, but accepts the same capture hidden behind a let-bound closure and a normally typed Tasks.fork-style helper. Literal and wrapper no-capture controls both pass. All are source checks; no race execution was attempted. The aliases and helper lose the task-boundary capture requirement. Current Cinch conservatively refuses the opaque callback wrapper. A correction must preserve safe wrappers and propagate real capture/transfer/lifetime requirements across aliases, helpers and interfaces; treating unknown functions as universally shareable is not a correction. Initial CLI-flag and added-alias-syntax mistakes are separately retained; this completed five-case result uses valid syntax and the documented Native check command.
